L13·N2973unmasked layer
Rather than a lexical detector, this unit marks connective/boundary tokens by whether they introduce a continuing specification versus a list item: it is positively driven by tokens that hand off to an appositive/description (a closing ")", " entitled", " is", " to", a comma before a defining phrase) and strongly *suppressed* by coordinating separators in enumerations ("and", "&", commas joining parallel items).

This neuron fires at the junction where a noun phrase gets a postmodifier — on the relativizer/preposition ("problems **that** are…", "pals **of** ours", "friend **of** mine") or on the head noun immediately preceding a reduced relative clause ("destination **markets** for…", "**challenges** Israel faces"); it is suppressed on prepositions/verbs in ordinary predicate continuations and on colons.
